definitions.gloss: the natural world; the world of nature
definitions.explanation: The physical world of plants, animals, and natural phenomena, as opposed to the human or artificial world.

examples.japanese: {自然界|しぜんかい}には{多|おお}くの{不思議|ふしぎ}がある。
examples.english: There are many wonders in the natural world.

examples.japanese: {自然界|しぜんかい}のバランスが{崩|くず}れつつある。
examples.english: The balance of the natural world is being disrupted.

examples.japanese: {自然界|しぜんかい}では{弱肉強食|じゃくにくきょうしょく}が{基本|きほん}であり、{生|い}き{残|のこ}るために{動物|どうぶつ}たちは{日々|ひび}{戦|たたか}っている。
examples.english: In the natural world, survival of the fittest is fundamental, and animals fight daily to survive.

notes:
FORMATION: {自然|しぜん} (nature) + {界|かい} (world, realm). The suffix ～{界|かい} denotes a sphere or realm (cf. {芸能界|げいのうかい} 'entertainment world', {学界|がっかい} 'academic world').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然界|しぜんかい}の{法則|ほうそく}: laws of nature
- {自然界|しぜんかい}に{存在|そんざい}する: to exist in nature
- {自然界|しぜんかい}のバランス: the balance of nature
- {自然界|しぜんかい}の{生態系|せいたいけい}: the ecosystem of the natural world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自然界|しぜんかい}: the natural world (emphasizes it as a distinct realm)
- {自然|しぜん}: nature (broader, more general)
- {自然環境|しぜんかんきょう}: natural environment (focuses on surroundings)
